description:
In the 2021 NHL Outdoors at Lake Tahoe series against the Philadelphia Flyers, Charlie Coyle secured the decisive game-winning goal in the late stages of the second period. Exploiting a turnover by the Flyers in the neutral zone, Coyle executed a spin move and delivered a backhand pass to Craig Smith. Upon entering the offensive zone, Coyle received a return pass from Smith, skated towards the net, and unleashed a wrist shot that eluded the goaltender for the goal.

description:
In the 2023 NHL Winter Classic against the Pittsburgh Penguins, Jake DeBrusk emerged as the hero for the Boston Bruins, netting both goals in their 2-1 win. Following Casey DeSmith's denial of Taylor Hall's attempt, DeBrusk capitalized on the rebound, banking it in to break the tie.

description:
In the waning moments of the second period in the 2016 NHL Winter Classic, goaltender Mike Condon delivered the standout moment of the game with a remarkable glove save. Condon's stellar performance continued, stopping 27 of the 28 shots he faced, contributing significantly to the 5-1 victory over the longtime rival Boston Bruins. In the process, Condon became the first rookie goaltender to win an NHL outdoor game.

description:
In the 2021 NHL Outdoors at Lake Tahoe series against the Vegas Golden Knights, Nathan MacKinnon netted a stunning goal, propelling Colorado to its second lead of the game, one they maintained. Starting from deep in the defensive zone, MacKinnon seized control of the puck and swiftly carried it up the ice. Accelerating into the offensive zone, he unleashed a powerful wrist shot that found the far side of the net, going post and in.

description:
In the Carolina Hurricanes first ever outdoor game, Teuvo Teravainen scored a goal on a beautiful passing play that put the finishing touches on a 4-1 victory over the Washington Capitals. Beginning with a Capitals dump in, goaltender Frederik Andersen gathers the puck and sends a stretch pass to Teravainen who is positioned at the far blue line. Now on a 2-on-1 break, Teravainen executes a give-and-go with Martin Necas before tapping it into the open net.
